data.title: High-affinity fully-humanized anti-Her 2 monoclonal antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
data.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, discloses a high-affinity fully-humanized anti-Her 2 monoclonal antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, and in particular discloses an anti-Her 2 monoclonal antibody. Ab5 and Ab8 antibodies were identified from a library of human natural phage antibodies, ab5m being an Ab5 antibody affinity-matured by introducing amino acid mutations in the Complementarity Determining Regions (CDRs) of the heavy chain variable region. The Her2 antibody has different sequences and different antigen epitope recognition regions from the published similar antibodies, and has better antigen binding capacity and higher anti-tumor efficacy compared with the commercial antibody herceptin. In addition, ab5m showed higher Her2 antigen affinity values and greater antitumor capacity.

data.title: Anti-HER2 antibody variants
data.abstract: The present invention concerns novel antibody variants, particularly anti-HER2 antibody variants having substitutions at positions within the variable domains of the heavy and light chains.

data.title: Method for making humanized antibodies
data.abstract: Variant immunoglobulins, particularly humanized antibody polypeptides are provided, along with methods for their preparation and use. Consensus immunoglobulin sequences and structural models are also provided.

data.title: Production of hersintuzumab: a new humanized antibody against HER2 for cancer treatment
data.abstract: A monoclonal anti-HER2 antibody is mutated on complementarity determining regions (CDRs) and framework regions. The VH domain of the antibody includes a portion of the amino acid sequence as SEQ ID NO: 1. The VL domain of the antibody includes a portion of the amino acid sequence as SEQ ID NO: 5.

data.title: Anti-her2 antibodies and their uses
data.abstract: The present disclosure relates to antibodies directed to HER2 and uses of such antibodies, for example to treat diseases associated with the activity and/or overproduction of HER2.

data.title: Monoclonal antibodies against HER2 antigens, and uses therefor
data.abstract: The present invention provides and includes monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) preferentially selective for HER2 antigens, hybridoma lines that secrete these HER2 antibodies or antibody fragments, and the use of such antibodies and antibody fragments to detect HER2 antigens, particularly those expressed by cancer cells. The present invention also includes antibodies that are specific for or show preferential binding to a soluble or secreted form of HER2. The present invention also includes an antibody or antibody fragment that is capable of reducing the activity of HER2 in at least one form, including a soluble form or a secreted form. The present invention further includes chimeric antibodies, processes for producing monoclonal and chimeric antibodies or monoclonal or chimeric antibodies, and their therapeutic uses, particularly in the detection of cancer most preferentially in human breast, stomach, and colon. The present invention further includes methods and kits for the immunodetection and immunotherapy of cells for samples which express HER2 antigens.

data.title: Methods of treatment using anti-erbb antibody-maytansinoid conjugates
data.abstract: The application concerns methods of treatment using anti-ErbB receptor antibody-maytansinoid conjugates, and articles of manufacture suitable for use in such methods. In particular, the invention concerns ErbB receptor-directed cancer therapies, using anti-ErbB receptor antibody-maytansinoid conjugates.

data.title: Methods of treatment using anti-erbb antibody-maytansinoid conjugates
data.abstract: The application concerns methods of treatment using anti-ErbB receptor antibody-maytansinoid conjugates, and articles of manufacture suitable for use in such methods. In particular, the invention concerns ErbB receptor-directed cancer therapies, using anti-ErbB receptor antibody-maytansinoid conjugates.

data.title: Humanized or affinity-matured anti ang-2 antibody and uses thereof
data.abstract: An anti-Ang2 antibody or an antigen-binding fragment thereof that specifically binds to an angiogenesis-inducing factor Angiopoietin-2 (Ang2) and complexes with a Tie2 receptor through Ang2, and methods of using the same.

data.title: Anti-HER2 and anti-IGF-IR BI-specific antibodies and uses thereof
data.abstract: Disclosed are antibodies, or binding fragments thereof, that specifically bind to human HER2 and human IGF-IR. Also provided are nucleic acid molecules encoding the disclosed antibodies and binding fragments and vectors and host cells containing these nucleic acid molecules. The disclosure also provides methods of inhibiting cancer cell growth and metastasis in a mammal using the antibodies described herein, as well as compositions containing the antibodies, nucleic acid molecules encoding the antibodies, and host cells and vectors comprising the nucleic acid molecules. The disclosure also features the use of the polypeptides to detect the presence of HER2 and IGF-IR in a mammal, and epitopes that can be used as cancer vaccine immunogens.

data.title: Humanized and affinity-matured anti-c-met antibody and uses thereof
data.abstract: Provided is a humanized and affinity-matured anti-c-Met antibody, a pharmaceutical composition including the antibody, and a method of preventing and/or treating c-Met-related disease using the antibody.

data.title: Anti-HER antibodies
data.abstract: The invention provides anti-HER antibodies, including multispecific anti-HER antibodies, compositions comprising and methods of using these antibodies. Also provided herein are EGFR/HER3 multispecific antibodies that are less toxic than traditional EGFR antagonists.

data.title: Combination Therapy Using Anti-EGFR and Anti-HER2 Antibodies
data.abstract: The invention relates to the combined use of anti-EGFR antibodies and anti-Her2 antibodies for the treatment of cancer, especially suitable for cancer expressing high levels of the EGFR type and low levels of HER2. The invention refers in particular monoclonal antibody “trastuzumab” (HERCEPTIN®) directed against the HER2 receptors the efficacy of which can be significantly increased in vivo when combined with monoclonal antibody “matuzumab” (hmAB 425, EMD 72000) directed against EGF receptors. The combination treatment is suitable for patients suffering from cancer having said receptor profile, preferably pancreatic cancer.

data.title: Affinity matured cd47-specific humanized antibody
data.abstract: The present invention relates to an affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody and, more specifically, to an affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody and a pharmaceutical composition comprising the affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody, for preventing or treating a disease mediated by cells overexpressing CD47. In the present invention, a humanized antibody (Hu3A5V10 antibody) was prepared by using a CD47-binding antibody (3A5 antibody), and the humanized anti-CD47 antibody was confirmed to bind specifically to a CD47 antigen. In addition, three types of the humanized anti-CD47 antibody in which affinity of the humanized anti-CD47 antibody was matured were prepared, and these antibodies were confirmed to have increased binding strength and affinity with the antigen. Thus, the affinity matured humanized antibody binding specifically to CD47 according to the present invention can be effectively applied to the prevention or treatment of diseases or tumors in which the immune response is suppressed by overexpression of CD47.

data.title: HER2 antibody composition
data.abstract: A composition comprising a main species HER2 antibody that binds to domain II of HER2, and an amino acid sequence variant thereof comprising an amino-terminal leader extension is disclosed. Pharmaceutical formulations comprising the composition, and therapeutic uses for the composition are also disclosed.

data.title: Therapeutic anti-her2 antibody fusion polypeptides
data.abstract: Therapeutic protein fusions comprising anti-HER2 antibody and MicB sequences are described along with methods for their production and use

data.title: Affinity matured humanized antibody specific for CD47
data.abstract: The present invention relates to an affinity matured humanized antibody specific to CD 47, and more specifically, to an affinity matured humanized antibody specific to CD 47, and a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating diseases mediated by cells overexpressing CD47 and comprising the affinity matured humanized antibody specific to CD 47. In the present invention, a humanized antibody (Hu3A5V10 antibody) is manufactured by using an antibody (3A5 antibody) bound with CD47, and it was confirmed that the humanized anti-CD47 antibody is specifically bound with the CD 47 antibody. In addition, three types of humanized anti-CD47 antibodies, having the affinity of the humanized anti-CD47 antibody matured, are manufactured, and it is confirmed that the antibodies have a binding force and the affinity with antigens increased. Accordingly, the affinity matured humanized antibody binding specifically with CD 47 can be effectively applied to the prevention or treatment of diseases or tumors inhibiting immune reactions by overexpression of CD47.

data.title: Bispecific HER2 antibodies and methods of use
data.abstract: The present invention relates to bispecific HER2 antibodies, novel HER2 antibody variants, methods for their production, pharmaceutical compositions containing said antibodies, and uses thereof.

data.title: Antibody formulations
data.abstract: The present application describes antibody formulations, including monoclonal antibodies formulated in histidine-acetate buffer, as well as a formulation comprising an antibody that binds to domain II of HER2 (for example, Pertuzumab), and a formulation comprising an antibody that binds to DR5 (for example, Apomab).

data.title: Methods and materials for treating cancer
data.abstract: This document provides methods and materials for treating a mammal having HER2-expressing cancers. For example, antibody drug conjugates containing an anti-HER2 antibody and at least one molecule of an anti-cancer drug are provided, as well as methods of administering such antibody drug conjugates to a mammal (e.g., a human) having a HER2-expressing cancer to treat the mammal.
